reviewer: root GPT-6; AI review, not human ground truth
research_purpose: Measure explicit employer language about entrance opportunities, experience objects and task responsibility with auditable text evidence; do not manufacture a latent seniority score.
reuse: Reuse normalization, exact-text deduplication and the frozen 10000-record sample. Do not restart full-corpus cleaning or Qwen inference.

development_review.coverage_note: Read the twelve full-document packet entries across tool outputs; approximately one recruitment-disclaimer sentence in document 2 was truncated by the tool. This is not a claim to have semantically reviewed all 120 documents.
material_findings: Document 42 has degree-specific years on separate bullet lines separated by standalone OR. Those year amounts cannot be treated as universally required.
The same document appends an application questionnaire. Entry Level is one software-proficiency answer option, not an entry-level vacancy classification.
Document 41 states years of ability and proficiency without the word experience. A literal experience rule will miss those: diagnose this limitation, do not silently claim complete years coverage.
Document 44 mentions mentoring junior resources in a senior role: junior text presence is not the advertised job's seniority.
Document 83 explicitly describes a Canada-based role. The current sample must not be labeled a verified US-only sample.
Technical requirements, client contact and responsibility are separate dimensions; explicit phrase matches cannot establish seniorization or actual technology adoption.

changes: Flag multiline OR/education/year documents conservatively and withhold unconditional experience classifications, while retaining original clause evidence.
Exclude the tail beginning with a specific application-questionnaire marker; retain an exclusion flag.
Do not interpret professional experience followed by an unrecognized specialty as unrestricted general experience.
Withhold object classifications for unqualified business prose such as experience design without a candidate-experience assertion.
Add four synthetic regression cases to the existing 17, for 21 total.
accepted_limitations: The technology and task lexicons are intentionally bounded. A no-match is not validated absence.
Multiline alternatives are flagged, not fully parsed; document-level caution may overflag otherwise clear clauses.
The questionnaire-tail exclusion is conservative and can omit later genuine prose.
Conditional alternatives and ambiguous objects require separate interpretation; no universally required years are imputed.

production_contract.execution: BU SCC scheduled CPU jobs only; no new inference model or API
production_contract.validation: Source SHA, complete row mapping, unchanged weights, exact evidence offsets and held-out diagnostic review; synthetic success does not prove semantic accuracy. Prior v1.1 scheduled job 7960588 completed 120/120 with 2645 exact evidence coordinates and zero processing errors; v1.2 must rerun all 21 tests before production.
production_contract.outputs: Six descriptive tables for the frozen sample plus evidence, unknowns and processing receipts. These are not all-LinkUp population estimates.
production_contract.weights: Preserve existing weights; report unweighted sample descriptions until a distinct estimator contract is justified.
production_contract.arms: A/B/C are pre-existing sampling strata, not newly validated technology roles. C is residual within a technology-prefiltered frame, not a general untreated control.
production_contract.time: Created year describes posting cohorts attached to the current text snapshot. It does not verify the text historically observed in that year.
production_contract.revelio: No individual work histories are available. Vendor schema audit does not establish a row-level join.

stop_rule: Freeze after this development pass and scheduled mechanical checks. Do not tune against the 80 held-out documents. Restrict or withhold a field if evaluation exposes a material semantic failure.
